summary: 松弛的蓝铅笔旅行速写，以少量暖橙强调人物动作和关键道具。
planner_guidance: Stage each beat as one candid travel memory with complete people and two or three naturally separated props.
aesthetic: Loose blue-pencil contours with visible pressure variation, a few dry colored-pencil fills, simple expressive faces, and broad untouched space.
paper: Clean warm-white drawing paper without a photographed desk, page frame, ruling, or heavy grain.
palette: Prussian blue and dusty cyan pencil with one restrained warm-orange accent, light tan skin tones, and much paper white.
avoid: photorealism, glossy digital paint, smooth vector fills, dense scenery, generated writing, logos, gradients, cropped people or props
